T: Road trip. Fishing rods. Snacks for the whole drive.
D: Goofy drags his teenage son Max on a cross-country fishing trip just as Max is trying to impress Roxanne.
P: Serve the mains when Goofy and Max finally make camp by Lake Destiny.
S: the father and son fishing move, Lake Destiny in Idaho
White fish strips dipped in flour, egg and panko, fried at 180C for 3 minutes until golden, with lemon wedges and a quick tartare of mayo, pickles and capers.
Goofy's plan to take Max fishing at Lake Destiny, Idaho

Thick potato wedges roasted crisp with paprika and garlic salt, loaded with melted cheddar, bacon bits and spring onion, sour cream for dipping. Heat the oven to 220C. Cut 1.2kg potatoes into thick wedges, toss with 3 tbsp oil, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp garlic salt, and roast on lined trays for 35 minutes, turning once. Fry 150g diced bacon until crisp. Pile the wedges onto one tray, scatter with 150g grated cheddar and the bacon and bake 5 minutes more until melted. Top with 2 sliced spring onions and serve with 200g sour cream.
Max telling everyone he'll be on stage at the Powerline concert

Corn chips layered with spiced beef mince, black beans and cheddar, baked until melted, then loaded with guacamole, sour cream and fresh tomato salsa. Heat the oven to 200C. Brown 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion, then add 2 tsp mild taco spice, 400g drained black beans and 125ml water and simmer 5 minutes. Spread 300g corn chips on a large tray, spoon over the mince and cover with 200g grated cheddar. Bake 8 minutes until melted. Mash 2 avocados with lime and salt. Dice 2 tomatoes with coriander. Top the nachos with guacamole, salsa and 150g sour cream.
M: Pete and PJ's campsite, with the giant RV
Thick beef sausages grilled over coals until charred, in soft rolls with fried onions, mustard and tomato sauce, corn on the cob on the side.
Bigfoot camp chilli beef and beans
the night Bigfoot crashes Goofy and Max's campsite

Chunky beef slow cooked with kidney beans, tomato and smoked paprika until thick and rich, topped with cheddar and sour cream, cornbread or crusty bread alongside. Toss 1kg diced chuck in 2 tbsp flour and brown in batches in a heavy pot. Fry 2 diced onions and 1 red capsicum for 5 minutes, then add 2 garlic cloves, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp ground cumin and 1 tsp mild chilli powder. Pour in 800g tinned tomatoes and 500ml beef stock, return the beef, cover and simmer 2 hours. Add 2 drained 400g tins kidney beans and cook 20 minutes more. Serve with cheddar, sour cream and crusty bread.
W: Bigfoot helps himself to everything at the campsite
Toast marshmallows over a flame until golden and squash them between plain biscuits with a square of milk chocolate so it melts.
K: Max and Roxanne at the big concert in LA
Cherry cordial blended with lots of ice and a squeeze of lime until slushy, served in tall cups with a straw.

s.note: the father and son fishing move, Lake Destiny in Idaho
s.how: Cut 600g white fish fillets into fingers. Dip in 50g flour, then 2 beaten eggs, then 120g panko. Fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden and drain. Mix 150g mayonnaise with 2 chopped dill pickles and 1 tbsp capers for tartare and serve with lemon wedges.

s.note: Max telling everyone he'll be on stage at the Powerline concert
s.how: Heat the oven to 200C. Brown 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion, then add 2 tsp mild taco spice, 400g drained black beans and 125ml water and simmer 5 minutes. Spread 300g corn chips on a large tray, spoon over the mince and cover with 200g grated cheddar. Bake 8 minutes until melted. Mash 2 avocados with lime and salt. Dice 2 tomatoes with coriander. Top the nachos with guacamole, salsa and 150g sour cream.

m.note: Pete and PJ's campsite, with the giant RV
m.how: Grill 8 thick beef sausages over hot coals or a barbecue for 12 minutes, turning, until charred. Fry 2 sliced onions in oil until soft and sweet. Grill 4 corn cobs for 10 minutes and brush with butter. Serve the sausages in 8 long rolls with the onions, yellow mustard and tomato sauce.

w.note: Bigfoot helps himself to everything at the campsite
w.how: Toast 16 large marshmallows on skewers over a gas flame or under a hot grill until golden. Squash each between 2 plain biscuits with a square of milk chocolate, 32 biscuits and 200g chocolate in total, and leave 30 seconds so the chocolate starts to melt.

d.note: Max and Roxanne at the big concert in LA
d.how: Blend 200ml cherry cordial with 600g ice, 200ml cold water and the juice of 1 lime until smooth and slushy. Pour into 4 tall cups and serve straight away with straws before it melts.
